newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - BANGLADESH NEWSPAPERS - AUG 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - BANGLADESH NEWSPAPERS - AUG 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Bangladesh will hold village council elections in December.
The Indo-Bangladesh Joint River Commission, after inspecting the changing course of the river Teesta, decided on Monday to construct a 1.75 kilometre-long embankment on its right bank.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina is likley to visit Indonesia and the Philippines next month.
A young woman and her two sons drowned when a country boat capsized in the river Meghna on Monday.
Five policemen were arrested on Monday on charge of torturing an under-trial prisoner to death at a police station in Chittagong.
Opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) leader Begum Khaleda Zia on Monday called upon all Islamic groups and religious-minded people to rally round her party.
The Securities and Exchange Commission is considering to permit 14 new merchant banks.
Some 150 fertiliser traders have surrendered their licenses complaining of "business-hostile" situation. REUTER
